submission.natural_language_explanation: L7/N2069+ detects a bounded part, portion or component of a larger whole. It peaks on a noun that names a component or subdivision of a structured object (body parts: chest, shoulder, neck, finger, muscle, tissue; subdivisions: line, page, row, string, set, piece, byte, scene), and on the ' of' of a partitive or measure construction where a portion/measure/collection noun is tied to the substance it portions out ('a bottle of water' 1.03, 'a kilogram of sugar' 1.27, 'two cups of flour' 0.76, '500 mg of amoxicillin' 1.58); a measure or unit noun also peaks when directly preceded by an expressed number ('5 meters' 1.56 vs 'meters' 0.16). It stays at its floor when the same head noun heads a genitive or property relation ('the colour of water' 0.02, 'the price of sugar' 0.00, 'the glass of the window' 0.04, 'the crust of bread' 0.11) and when a unit noun has no expressed number ('distances in meters' 0.18); a plain counted object after a number does not fire ('5 apples' 0.00).
